title: Viva Insights: Copilot Analytics Agent Dashboard for agent adoption and Copilot Credit usage
summary: Hold: the licensing classification overlooks Microsoft's published inclusion of the Agent Dashboard with qualifying licences. The policy-precedence explanation also omits that user and group policies override tenant policies, which could lead an administrator to rely on an ineffective tenant-wide restriction.

claims.quote:

ModuleId : VivaInsights
FeatureId : AgentDashboard
Name : DisableFeatureForAll
IsFeatureEnabled : false
Everyone

claims.claim: One additional policy per feature can be assigned to the entire tenant.

claims.claim: Where a user has several policies, the most restrictive policy applies, without a policy-scope qualification.
claims.quote: The most restrictive Policy Scope Level takes precedence first. Then within a single Policy Scope Level, the most restrictive Enablement Policy takes precedence.
claims.fix: Replace 'the most restrictive policy applies where a user has several' with 'user or group policies take priority over a tenant-wide policy; where multiple user or group policies apply, the most restrictive applies'. This qualification is also stated in the cited Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy reference.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy requires Global Administrators membership or a role assigned at the feature level.
claims.quote: Currently, you need to be a member of the Global Administrators role or the roles that have been assigned at the feature level to run this cmdlet.
